title: E2E.Test.RAR5.CollidingMemberPaths.2026.1080p-TESTGRP
description: One stored RAR5 whose two members differ only by case (CERTIFICATE/BACKUP/id.bdmv and CERTIFICATE/backup/id.bdmv). Extraction folds case before it writes, so the archive is refused at open; the job must fail promptly with that refusal instead of re-scheduling the same member forever.
